scope: Upstream DRW_Hatch::angle and DRW_Hatch::PatternLine::angle unit contract for HATCH and MPOLYGON, plus DXF boundary conversion and LibreCAD origin/master compile compatibility.
trigger: A clean LibreCAD origin/master adapter compile rejected the overlaid upstream header because DRW_HATCH_ANGLE_RADIANS was absent. LibreCAD's filter contract and current adapter consume the fields as radians.
decision: Advertise DRW_HATCH_ANGLE_RADIANS=1; expose both public pattern-angle fields in radians. DXF groups 52/53 are degrees and are converted on parse/write. DWG HATCH and MPOLYGON angle fields are radians and pass through unchanged.

authority.dwg_specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.75, lists HATCH pattern angles as BD fields (the section does not explicitly name their units).
authority.independent_wire_evidence: docs/research/p6-dwg-hatch-pattern-angle-units-2026-11-04.json contains the hash-bound ODA/LibreDWG evidence for radians on the selected DWG wire and degrees in the returned DXF. That evidence establishes wire units; its earlier public-field choice is superseded by this consumer-alignment slice.
authority.consumer_contract: LibreCAD origin/master rs_filterdxfrw.cpp requires DRW_HATCH_ANGLE_RADIANS == 1 and passes the public field to its radian-valued hatch model.

implementation: src/drw_entities.h defines the public radians marker and documents both fields in radians.

src/drw_entities.cpp converts DXF groups 52/53 from degrees to radians; DWG HATCH parsing retains wire radians and DWG encoding writes radians directly. MPOLYGON DWG handling was already radian-valued.
src/libdxfrw.cpp converts public radians to DXF degrees for both HATCH and MPOLYGON writers.
Tests and DWG authoring tools now pass radian values into the public API; README documents the contract.

validation.consumer_compile: cmake --build /private/tmp/librecad-upstream-libdxfrw-check-build --target librecad_filter_compile_check -j6: PASS against LibreCAD origin/master with the upstream libdxfrw overlay. The LibreCAD source emitted one existing switch warning covering four associative-prefix enum values not handled by its status mapper.

coverage: The locally generated focused DXF selector inspects emitted raw groups 52/53 and confirms degree-valued values, then reads ASCII and Binary HATCH and MPOLYGON back and checks radian-valued fields. The DWG selector checks emitted radian BD values and AC1015/AC1018/AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 writer profiles, nonfinite refusal, truncation reset and corrected HATCH retry, plus AC1021 MPOLYGON DWG parser/readback. The HATCH reference graph, MPOLYGON metadata boundary and encoder-allocation rollback selectors also pass.
limits: This changes the numeric meaning of the public HATCH/MPOLYGON angle fields from the briefly exposed degree-valued upstream API. Source-level callers using those fields must use radians; the marker makes the contract detectable. The DXF file representation remains degrees and generated output is unchanged in meaning.

The LibreCAD result is a clean filter translation-unit compile against origin/master and a local library overlay, not a full application build, native runtime test, ABI qualification, LibreCAD_3 application run, or Linux/Windows qualification.
The switch warning in LibreCAD's associative-prefix status mapper remains a downstream follow-up.
This does not qualify broad HATCH/MPOLYGON producer semantics, rendering, gradient meaning, or whole-file support.
fixture_policy: The new DXF sources are generated at test runtime from scratch; no DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
